$description: Reviewed exceptions to the whole-page-wrapper quality gate in extraction/verify_all.py (check P). The thresholds themselves (HERO >1800px warns, HERO >3000px fails, one section holding more than half of a page's height warns) are constants in verify_all.py and cannot be loosened from this file. An entry here is the ONLY way to pass a gate that would otherwise fail or warn, and it must carry a justification, a reviewer and a date. verify_all.py fails on an entry that is malformed, names an unknown section or route, no longer triggers (stale), or whose cap (allowedUpToPx) is exceeded by the current measurement.

gates.height-fail: A HERO-category section measured above 3000px. Needs allowedUpToPx (a hard cap that still fails if exceeded).
gates.majority: One section holding more than 50% of its page's measured height (a whole-page wrapper in disguise).

whitelist.justification: A legal page is one long prose document by design: legal.header is a short title block and legal.body is the clause list, so the body is expected to dominate (67% of 1835px measured at 1440px). It is a prose section of ordinary section height (1228px), not a single wrapper that swallows the page's other sections; the page has no other content sections to split from it.
